theorem mathd_algebra_313 (v i z : ℂ) (h₀ : v = i * z) (h₁ : v = 1 + Complex.I)
  (h₂ : z = 2 - Complex.I) : i = 1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I := by
  have h_mul : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := calc
    i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [← h₂]
    _ = v := h₀.symm
    _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hI : Complex.I * Complex.I = -1 := Complex.I_mul_I
  have h_target : (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    have h_div : (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I : ℂ) = (1 + 3 * Complex.I) / (5 : ℂ) := by ring
    rw [h_div]
    have h_mul2 : (1 + 3 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) = 5 * (1 + Complex.I) := by
      calc (1 + 3 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I)
          = 2 + 6 * Complex.I - Complex.I - 3 * (Complex.I * Complex.I) := by ring
        _ = 2 + 6 * Complex.I - Complex.I - 3 * (-1) := by rw [hI]
        _ = 5 * (1 + Complex.I) := by ring
    calc (1 + 3 * Complex.I) / (5 : ℂ) * (2 - Complex.I)
        = (1 + 3 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) / (5 : ℂ) := by ring
      _ = 5 * (1 + Complex.I) / (5 : ℂ) := by rw [h_mul2]
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := by field_simp
  have h_eq : i * (2 - Complex.I) = (1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I) * (2 - Complex.I) := by
    rw [h_mul, h_target]
  have hne : (2 : ℂ) - Complex.I ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have h_im : ((2 : ℂ) - Complex.I).im = -1 := by simp
    rw [h] at h_im
    simp at h_im
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne h_eq
